about.title: Who we are
about.description: Filtrex s.r.o. is a Czech manufacturer of industrial plate filters and nanofiber filtration membranes. Our technology ensures high purity of filtered liquids in food industry, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals.

filtrex-d18-2020.name: FILTREX D18 20/20
filtrex-d18-2020.shortDescription: Plate nanofiber filter made of stainless steel, for filtering vegetable oils and cosmetics.
filtrex-d18-2020.description:
The FILTREX D18 20/20 plate filter is an industrial nanofiber filter (nanofilter) designed for filtering vegetable oils, cosmetics and other food-grade liquids. It uses the RIFTELEN N15 nanofiber filtration membrane to achieve high purity of the filtered product.

A variable number of plates allows the filtration area to be adapted to specific production needs.

The hygienic stainless steel design meets the most demanding requirements of the food industry.

riftelen-n15.name: RIFTELEN N15
riftelen-n15.shortDescription: Nanofiber filtration membrane for FILTREX plate filters.
riftelen-n15.description:
RIFTELEN® N15 is a nanofiber filtration membrane developed specifically for the FILTREX D18 20/20 plate filters. The membrane is protected by utility model 31084.

Advantages over classic filter cloth:
– Significantly lower pressure drop – increases the plate filter's throughput
– Gentler on the filtered liquid – allows filtration at lower pressure
– Higher air permeability – residual liquid can be pushed out with air after the filter cake has formed
– Hydrophobic surface – easier to clean
– Lower area weight

Available in the N15–5 (5 µm retention) and N15–12 (12 µm retention) variants.

filtrex-d11-4040.name: FILTREX D11 40/40
filtrex-d11-4040.shortDescription: Higher-capacity plate filter – in development, available by the end of the year.
filtrex-d11-4040.description: The FILTREX D11 40/40 plate filter is being developed as a higher-performance variant for larger filtration volumes. It will be available by the end of this year.
